newsitem.title: USA: Great Western urges holders against consent.
newsitem.headline: Great Western urges holders against consent.

text.p: Great Western Financial Corp, the target of a hostile takeover bid by H.F. Ahmanson and Co, said Wednesday it was urging stockholders not to sign Ahmanson's consent solicitation.

In a letter to shareholders, Great Western said Ahmanson's effort to solicit consents was a blatant attempt to limit the options and flexibility of Great Western's board in evaluating Ahmanson's proposal and related matters.
Great Western has not yet formally responded to the February 18 merger proposal. Various reports have suggested it is talking to other parties and may be seeking a white knight.
Great Western said its board and financial and legal advisers were carefully considering its responses to the Ahmanson proposal and would act all times in shareholders' best interests.
Ahmanson had no immediate comment on the Great Western statement.

One of Ahmanson's proposed by-law amendments could preclude the Great Western board from attracting potential bidders for Great Western. Great Western is challenging the legality of this proposed by-law amendment in Delaware Chancery Court.
